description: Štetje kolesarjev na državnem kolesarskem omrežju od leta 2013 dalje is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA INFRASTRUKTURO. A collection of documents on the number of cyclists at certain locations on the national cycling network. The location of the count itself is presented in the Numerous Towns on State Roads collection. The data are prepared on the basis of data from automatic traffic meters. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA INFRASTRUKTURO. The portal shows the English title as "Counting cyclists on the national cycling network since 2013" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA INFRASTRUKTURO. Its keywords include državne ceste, kolesarska steza, števna mesta, število kolesarjev, kolesa, štetje prometa. The listing shows 5 download or service links in HTML, CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
